explanation: I found no Mathlib lemma saying that the kernel ideal sheaf of a quasi-compact morphism with reduced source is radical, under any of the obvious names. I searched Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry for `radical`, `ker.radical`, `radical_ker`, `ker_radical`, `IsRadical`, and `ker` together with `vanishingIdeal`. I also checked the `IsReduced` section of IdealSheaf/Basic.lean, which only has `nilradical_eq_bot` and `support_eq_top_iff`. The library's proof works open by open: the ideal of `f.ker` at `U` is the preimage (`comap`) of `⊥` under `f.app U`. It then combines the generic facts `Ideal.isRadical_bot`, `IsRadical.comap` and `IsRadical.radical`. No single Mathlib declaration states the result.
